notes.title: March Recap – A Month of Madness
notes.content:
March has been an intense month, packed with reveals, updates, and major milestones for Tormentor. From the highly anticipated Madnight 2025 event to launching the Tormentor Kickstarter, we’ve been pushing forward at full speed. Let’s take a look at everything that went down this month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/e9f573d0b625eafe34e9ba97e1b2da6762cbcee4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Madnight 2025 – Unleashing the Nightmare[/h2]
Our annual Madnight showcase was dedicated to Tormentor, highlighting its brutal gameplay, dark themes, and the fight against censorship. During the event, we:[list][*] Showed gameplay commentary, giving a deep dive into Tormentor's mechanics and disturbing world.
[*] Revealed the torture minigame, breaking down its design and the twisted creativity behind it.
[*] Discussed how Nymphomaniac helped shape certain features in Tormentor and announced continued support for the game.
[*] Released a trailer for the Equinox Club update for Nymphomaniac.
[*] Conducted developer interviews, giving insight into torture animations, scripts, dialogues, and coding.
[*] Introduced Bloody Mary, a terrifying new character that brings a different kind of sadism to the game. 
[*] Unveiled the biggest and most important premiere in our studio’s history.
[/list]
🔗[b]Check out the Full Madnight 2025 Recap:[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1493440/announcements/detail/573751255204102462

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/3dcaed3e490f3adc8eb9a963d12958c0cff89de7.gif[/img]

[h2]The Tormentor Kickstarter [b]Page[/b] Is Now Live![/h2]
After months of buildup, Tormentor’s Kickstarter Page has finally launched! This is your chance to support the project and grab exclusive rewards. Every backer helps push the game to new heights, and your support is crucial in the fight against censorship. (The Campaign will begin mid-april.)

🔥 [b]Back Tormentor on Kickstarter:[/b]
🔗 [url=Kickstarter]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster[/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/aa78b442bb532897fdea6fbe0dcba59cf671c74a.png[/img][/url]

[h2]A Deep Dive Into Bloody Mary[/h2]
Following her reveal at Madnight, we took a closer look at Bloody Mary, showcasing her playstyle and new full-length Trailer.

🔗 Check out the Bloody Mary [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1493440/announcements/detail/573751255204103811]Steam Article[/url]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1493440/announcements/detail/573751255204103811

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/f8faa9d77bd928a790e904d7fc121b414c7fe226.gif[/img]


[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
With Tormentor’s Kickstarter underway, we are focused on bringing more updates, engaging with the community, and pushing toward our funding goal. Every bit of support counts.

March was a wild ride, but this is only the beginning. Thank you to everyone who has supported us so far. Let’s keep the momentum going!

🔗 Join the Community on [url=https://tinyurl.com/MadmindStudio]Discord[/url]

🔗 Wishlist Tormentor: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493440/TORMENTOR/

notes.title: Tormentress DLC for Succubus
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139853/152fa4659a0bf0795b77f3911a032e3a1565accd.jpg[/img]

We have something special for fans of dark adventures – a new DLC for [b]Succubus: Tormentress[/b], which offers even more kinky challenges and intense experiences.

[previewyoutube=i59sdCaON0g;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out our livestream, where we presented this new expansion with your favorite demon - Vydija [b]HOT[/b] surprise for you at the end - stay with us until the end!

[h1]SUCCUBUS: TORMENTRESS DLC[/h1]

Dive into the abyss with the new DLC for Succubus: Tormentress, available now on Steam! Take on the role of Tormentress, the dark embodiment of lust and pain.
Discover unique BDSM skins, new selfie poses, hot sex scenes, and much more.

[previewyoutube=YwX-IuXsf6U;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[b]Key features:[/b]

- New skins with unique powers

- New selfie poses

- Hot Sex Scenes

- New customization of the main hub

- New Combat Arena and Weapons

Enter the world of Succubus: Tormentress and discover your dark desires!

Join us and discover the dark new worlds we've prepared just for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959800/Succubus__Tormentress/

This add-on has an Adult Only rating, so to enable you to purchase it anywhere in the world, it will soon also appear in other online stores, including ours - YES, we will have our own store!

Even if you don't plan on purchasing the new DLC, we still have something cool for you. 
We've added a powerful new weapon, the metal staff, to the base game. Remember - update the files of the main game and all DLCs.

Enjoy!

// Madmind
